title: Academic council
summary: The collegial governing body: membership, meetings and decisions.

body.text: The Academic Council is the collegial governing body of the university, addressing education, research and administrative matters.

items: Approval of degree programmes and curricula.

body.text: Meetings follow the council’s annual plan. Minutes and decisions are published in the Documents section.
